notes.title: Version V1.0.4 Update Notes - June 17
notes.notes:
Update Content:

1.Fixed an issue where some sound effects did not play correctly.
2.Fixed an issue where certain achievements could not be obtained normally.
3.Optimized the behavior of max HP items to prevent incorrect HP adjustments when rearranged.
4.Adjusted the values of some weapons.
5.Fixed special attack anomalies with the "Battleaxe Steak" series of weapons.
6.Adjusted mud blocks so that they can now be destroyed by all weapon special attacks.
7.Optimized the height of cacti in the Desert Stage.
8.Fixed an issue where blue health was incorrectly deducted during trades with the Mysterious Merchant.
9.Improved the invincibility duration during perfect dodges.

notes.title: Update on June 12 - Version V1.0.3
notes.notes:
1.Fixed a bug in the previous version where some map portals could not be opened properly.
2.Optimized and adjusted some maps.

notes.title: Emergency Update for Portal Anomaly
notes.notes:
英语:

A portal anomaly bug was discovered in version V1.0.2, and we have urgently rolled back to V1.0.1. We will fix the issue as soon as possible and release an update.

notes.title: Version V1.0.2 Update Notes - June 11
notes.notes:
Update Content:
1.Fixed an issue where some sound effects were not affected by the audio settings.
2.Fixed a bug where players could easily go out of bounds near the portal in Boss stages.
3.Removed the inertia during dash flying.
4.Adjusted the pattern of key appearance in the key event.
5.Corrected the effect error of Level 1 "Agility Rune Stone".
6.Fixed abnormal behavior with the "Life Ring" effect.
7.Resolved an issue where portals in Challenge Stages would sometimes fail to open.
8.Fixed a bug where falling into water on reward tiles in Challenge Mode would cause trap doors to close, leading to being stuck.

notes.title: June 9th, Version V1.0.1 Update Notes
notes.notes:
V1.0.1 Update Notes:

1.Fixed the issue where BGM and SFX settings in the options menu were not functioning properly.
2.Adjusted the drop rate of inventory expansion items from silver treasure chests.
3.Tweaked the attack intervals of all weapons; removed the long cooldown on the third hit of attack combos.
4.Improved the bullet time effect during perfect dodges.
5.Reduced the intensity of camera shake during attacks.
6.Removed the knockback effect caused when sweeping attacks hit obstacles.
7.Added an option to cap the frame rate in the settings menu.
8.Removed the default shield buffs on certain enemy spawns.
9.Fixed several collision detection bugs with environmental geometry.
10.Optimized the following behavior of summoned pets.
11.Adjusted the damage values of certain enemies.

The Witch and the Doughnut Cat is a light meat-pigeon ARPG that incorporates backpack management. In the game the player takes on the role of the little witch and helps the Gnocchi Cats to reclaim the cans that have been taken by monsters. But as you explore deeper, you realize that things are not as simple as they seem ......
